class.name: FoxCharacterState
class.brief_description: Base state for all character-driven states in the Foxbox framework.
class.description: [FoxCharacterState] extends the generic [FoxState] by introducing strictly typed variables for core character components. These variables are automatically injected by the parent [FoxCharacterStateMachine] during initialization. Specific implementations should extend this class and use [annotation @export] to define their own specific motor needs.

members.member: The physics node of the character. Used by states and motors to apply velocity, detect floors, and handle world collisions.
The visual and animation controller for the character. Used by states to command stances (e.g., crouch, stand) and trigger animations.
Mediator for the entire character that exposes a huge API and inputs.
